title: chore(console): refresh vendored objectui SPA to d006128c
body:
## What

Refresh the vendored `@object-ui/console` SPA pinned in `.objectui-sha` from `46a12ef9` → `d006128c` (6 upstream commits) and ship the changeset that bumps `@objectstack/console` (minor).

## Upstream changes pulled in

- feat(detail): wire object fieldGroups into detail sections; read hints from spec-writable `detail.*` block (objectstack-ai/objectui#2148)
- fix(form): render object fieldGroups in create/edit modal; auto-layout parity for grouped ObjectForm (objectstack-ai/objectui#2152)
- fix(grid): refresh list after a bulk/row action succeeds (objectstack-ai/objectui#2159)
- fix(grid): inline-edit toggle takes effect immediately + staged editor closes on save (objectstack-ai/objectui#2151)
- fix(components): keep dialog/drawer open when a click closes an open dropdown (objectstack-ai/objectui#2157)

## Verification

- `pnpm run build` (70/70) → `scripts/build-console.sh` at `d006128c` → 35/35 turbo tasks green, dist 42112 KB.
- Bundle canary `import/jobs` present — confirms THIS framework's `@objectstack/client` is injected into the SPA (the fix from `console-bundle-own-client`, which also lands in this release, guards against the stale-client bug that broke 11.5.0's console at runtime).
- `check:console-sha` gate passes (dist stamp matches pin).
- `packages/console/dist` is gitignored and rebuilt in CI at publish.
